description: This file contains unit tests for ADO.NET client stream functionality across different database providers (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL) within the Orleans framework. It defines test classes for each database type and a base class that sets up the testing environment, configuration, and test execution logic.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetClientStreamTests
classes.description: Test class for SQL Server ADO.NET client stream functionality.

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetClientStreamTests
classes.description: Test class for MySQL ADO.NET client stream functionality.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetClientStreamTests
classes.description: Test class for PostgreSQL ADO.NET client stream functionality.

classes.name: AdoNetClientStreamTests
classes.description: Abstract base class providing setup, configuration, and common test methods for ADO.NET client stream tests across different database providers.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test environment asynchronously, setting up the relational storage and test runner.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with silo and client builder configurators.

methods.name: AdoNetStreamProducerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Test method for verifying producer behavior when client is dropped.

methods.name: AdoNetStreamConsumerOnDroppedClientTest
methods.description: Test method for verifying consumer behavior when client is dropped.
